title: Confirm intent-2: route_l1_1 straight is 0.30 um off the bend axis at both ends (y=-81.65 and y=-174.0)
evidence: Walk of route_l1_1 with rv.cross_section every 0.25 um (work/microscope/walk.py): ridge centre jumps +0.2989 um at (657.05,-81.87) and -0.2992 um at (656.75,-174.16); no other jump >0.01 um on the route. Ridge straight x 656.55..657.55 (centre 657.05), both R=80.0 bends end on x=656.75 (circle fits 79.50/80.50 um sides). LN_SLAB of the straight stays centred on 656.75 (ridge sits 0.3 um off-centre in its slab). rv.junction_loss(offset=0.3)=0.903 dB, offset=0 -> 0.000 dB. The bend mode shift at R=80 is ~0.04 um outward, so joint 1 (outward) ~0.70 dB and joint 2 (inward) ~1.13 dB: ~1.8 dB in total. Picture work/microscope/p3a_l1_1_offset_top.png.
impact: ~1.8 dB extra on EC#12..EC#15 (half the tree).
fix: Put the vertical straight back on x=656.75 (656.25..657.25).

title: Confirm intent-3: 10.0 um of the route_l2_2 ridge is drawn on LN_SLAB, not LN_RIDGE (x 1546.846..1556.846, y=-127)
evidence: Walk of route_l2_2: 40 consecutive 0.25 um cuts with no LN_RIDGE from (1546.94,-127.0) to (1556.69,-127.0). rv.flat()['LN_SLAB'] holds a 10.000 x 1.000 um rectangle [1546.846,-127.5,1556.846,-126.5], exactly the missing ridge piece (the layer was changed); it merges into the 10 um slab, so the section is slab only. rv.junction_loss(layer2='LN_SLAB')=4.66 dB per ridge/slab transition. LVS opens the net (design_only [MMI#3.P2, MMI#6.P0]); basic DRC does not flag it (gap 10 um > 1 um space).
impact: Estimated >5 dB on EC#12 and EC#13 (two outputs of the 1x8 almost dead).
fix: Move the 10 x 1 um rectangle back to LN_RIDGE (2/0).

title: Confirm intent-4: 0.500 um ridge gap in route_in at x 489.239..489.739, y=0 (all 8 outputs)
evidence: Walk of route_in: no LN_RIDGE at the cuts x=489.375 and 489.625; ridge ends at 489.239 and restarts at 489.739, slab continuous. rv.drc(): LN_RIDGE.space<1.0 marker [489.239,-1,489.739,1]; LVS open N0/N9. My short-section mode expansion (work/microscope/eme.py, 80 local modes of the slab-only section, L=0.5 um, no reflection): 1.36 dB if the unexpanded 13% is lost, 0.18 dB if it all recombines; so 0.2 to 1.4 dB, plus some back-reflection from two abrupt ridge ends. Picture work/microscope/p1_route_in_gap.png.
impact: 0.2-1.4 dB on every output; may reach the >1 dB class. Back-reflection into the input fibre.
fix: Fill the ridge: one 360..500 um straight.

title: Confirm intent-6: route_l2_3 straight is 0.600 um wide over 367.05 um (x 1332.954..1700.0, y=-381)
evidence: Walk of route_l2_3: 1467 consecutive cuts read 0.6000 um from x=1333.19 to 1699.69, 1.0 um elsewhere. Cut 0.05 um each side of MMI#7.P0 (1700,-381): route side 0.6 um (-0.3..0.3), MMI side 1.001 um: abrupt step on axis. rv.modes: w=0.6 n_eff 1.7416 n_g 2.1505 vs w=1.0 1.7915/2.1898; rv.junction_loss(1.0,0.6)=0.030 dB per step. Pictures p5a/p5b_l2_3_narrow_*.png.
impact: ~0.06 dB on EC#14/EC#15 and a 14.4 um group-path (6.6 um equivalent length) mismatch of the branch.

title: Confirm intent-7: 0.400 um x 2.000 um neck in route_l1_0 at x=656.75, y 136.718..138.718
evidence: Walk of route_l1_0: 8 cuts (y 136.87..138.62) read 0.4000 um, centred on x=656.75 (no side offset); all other cuts 1.000 +-0.006 um. rv.junction_loss(1.0,0.4)=0.167 dB per step. Mode expansion over the 2 um neck (80 local modes of the 0.4 um ridge): 0.15 to 0.58 dB. Picture work/microscope/p2_l1_0_neck.png.
impact: 0.15-0.6 dB on EC#8..EC#11 (upper half of the tree).

title: Confirm intent-5 with transition loss: route_out_6 R=25.0 um circular bends cost ~0.95 dB, not 0.3-0.6 dB
evidence: Circle fits to the ridge sides (work/microscope/radius_fit.py): 24.500/25.500 um, residual <0.001 um, so centre R=25.0 um, circular (no Euler part), 2 x 90 deg, joined by an 11.85 um straight. All 16 other curved ridge polygons fit 79.50/80.50 (R=80.0) except route_out_1 (99.50/100.50, R=100). rv.modes(bend_radius=25): TE0 38.4 dB/cm -> 2 x 39.27 um = 0.30 dB radiation. Straight-to-bend TE0 E x H overlap (work/microscope/bend_overlap.py, same local solver): R=25 0.178 dB per transition, R=80 0.013 dB (solver floor). 4 abrupt transitions -> ~0.66 dB. Total ~0.96 dB vs ~0.02 dB for the sibling R=80 s-bends. Walked length 603.64 um vs 582.55 um for route_out_7 (+21.09 um). Picture p6_out_6_tight_bends.png.
impact: ~0.95 dB extra on EC#14 (upper edge of medium; roughness scattering in a tight bend can push it over 1 dB), and +21.1 um path length (154 fs skew).
fix: Use the R=80 s-bend (dx 126.36 um, dy 61.85 um) like route_out_7.

title: Confirm intent-8: route_out_1 s-bend is two R=100.0 um arcs (dx 144.62) and the route is 2.27 um short
evidence: Circle fits to both halves of the s-bend: sides 99.50/100.50 um (residual <0.001 um), R=100.0; the 61.85 um siblings fit 79.50/80.50 (R=80.0). Walked centre-line length 580.283 um vs route_out_0 582.551 um (-2.27 um). Width 1.000 +-0.006 um along the whole bend, joints on axis (end offset 0.000 um).
impact: No loss; 2.27 um path mismatch (4.5x the +-0.5 um tolerance).
fix: Use the dx 126.36 um R=80 s-bend.

title: Confirm intent-1: EC#13 port at y=-187.5; route_out_5 meets it on axis, so only the facet pitch is wrong
evidence: Walk of route_out_5 ends at y=-187.500 at x=2340 (EC#13.P0), cut 0.05 um each side: both 1.0 um, centred (offset 0.000). Its s-bend is two R=80.0 um arcs (fit 79.50/80.50) over dx 123.97, dy 58.85: built for the moved coupler. Walked length 581.104 um vs 582.55 um for the siblings (-1.45 um). Output facet y values 444.5, 317.5, 190.5, 63.5, -63.5, -187.5, -317.5, -444.5 (pitch 124/130 at EC#13).
